description: Will this Solana transfer succeed? A verdict for SOL or an SPL or Token-2022 token. When to use: Before building or signing a Solana transfer, to learn whether it will fail and what it will cost in rent and fees. Prefer another tool: Not a simulation of the exact transaction (no priority fee, no program logic), not a token price or holder lookup, and not a way to read raw accounts. Example: solana_transfer_readiness {"source":"83astBRguLMdt2h5U1Tpdq5tjFoJ6noeGwaY3mDLVcri","destination":"A1TMhSGzQxMr1TboBKtgixKz1sS6REASMxPo1qsyTSJd","mint":"SOL","amount":"0.5"}

amount.description: Positive decimal amount in UI units (SOL or tokens, not lamports or raw units)

destination.description: Receiving wallet (not its token account): Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes

mint.description: `SOL` for native SOL, or the mint address of an SPL Token or Token-2022 token

source.description: Sending wallet: Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes

name: solana_transfer_readiness

age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from Solana

commitment.description: Every read is at finalized commitment

slot.description: Context slot of the finalized read

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

amount.description: Amount checked, in the asset's UI units (as sent)

amount_raw.description: Amount in raw units (lamports for SOL)

ata_creation_lamports.description: Rent-exempt lamports to create the destination token account; null when not needed

decimals.description: Decimals of the asset (9 for SOL)

net_amount.description: Raw units the destination receives after any transfer fee

requires_ata_creation.description: True when the destination has no associated token account yet

token_program.description: Token program that owns the mint; null for SOL

transfer_fee.description: Token-2022 transfer fee in raw units; null without a fee config

title: Solana transfer readiness
